period.name: Mayatnik davri (kichik burchak)
period.description: Kichik (≲ 10°) og'ishlarda matematik mayatnikning tebranish davri massaga va amplitudaga bog'liq emas.

pendulum_exact.name: Mayatnik davri (aniq formula)
pendulum_exact.description: Ixtiyoriy amplitudadagi aniq davr (K — birinchi tur to'liq elliptik integral). θ₀ = 15° da T kichik burchak formulasidan ≈ 0,4 % katta.

gravity.name: Mayatnik yordamida g ni aniqlash
gravity.description: O'lchangan davr va ip uzunligidan erkin tushish tezlanishi hisoblanadi.

height.name: Erkin tushishda o'tilgan yo'l
height.description: Tinch holatdan erkin tushgan jismning t vaqtda o'tgan yo'li (havo qarshiligisiz).

fall_time.name: Tushish vaqti
fall_time.description: h balandlikdan tinch holatdan erkin tushish vaqti.

velocity.name: Erkin tushish tezligi
velocity.description: Tinch holatdan t vaqt davomida erkin tushgan jismning tezligi.

impact_speed.name: Yerga urilish tezligi
impact_speed.description: h balandlikdan tushgan jismning yerga urilish oldidagi tezligi (energiyaning saqlanishidan).

gravity_from_h.name: Tushish vaqtidan g ni aniqlash
gravity_from_h.description: O'lchangan tushish vaqti va balandlikdan erkin tushish tezlanishi.

newton_acceleration.name: Nyutonning ikkinchi qonuni
newton_acceleration.description: Gorizontal sirtdagi jism tezlanishi teng ta'sir etuvchi kuchga to'g'ri, massaga teskari proporsional. |F| ≤ f bo'lsa jism joyidan qo'zg'almaydi (a = 0).

incline_acceleration.name: Qiya tekislikdagi tezlanish
incline_acceleration.description: Qiya tekislikdan sirpanib tushayotgan jism tezlanishi massaga bog'liq emas. tg θ ≤ μ bo'lsa jism tinch turadi (a = 0).

incline_normal_force.name: Tayanchning reaksiya kuchi
incline_normal_force.description: Qiya tekislikka tik yo'nalgan reaksiya kuchi; ishqalanish kuchi f = μN.

spring_period.name: Prujinali mayatnik davri
spring_period.description: Prujinaga osilgan yukning tebranish davri amplitudaga bog'liq emas.

spring_constant.name: Davrdan bikrlikni aniqlash
spring_constant.description: O'lchangan davr va yuk massasidan prujina bikrligi.

spring_energy.name: Tebranishning to'liq energiyasi
spring_energy.description: Chetki nuqtada (v = 0) butun energiya prujinaning potensial energiyasiga teng.

projectile_range.name: Uchish uzoqligi
projectile_range.latex: L = v₀·cos θ · t,  t = (v₀ sin θ + √(v₀² sin²θ + 2g·h₀)) / g
projectile_range.description: h₀ balandlikdan gorizontga θ burchak ostida otilgan jismning uchish uzoqligi. h₀ = 0 da L = v₀²·sin 2θ / g.

projectile_max_height.name: Ko'tarilishning eng katta balandligi
projectile_max_height.description: Traektoriyaning eng yuqori nuqtasi yerdan qancha balandda ekani.

projectile_flight_time.name: Uchish vaqti
projectile_flight_time.description: Jism otilgan paytdan yerga tushguncha o'tgan vaqt.

momentum_total.name: Sistemaning to'liq impulsi
momentum_total.description: Yopiq sistemada to'qnashuvdan oldin va keyin impulslar yig'indisi o'zgarmaydi. Tezlik o'ngga musbat, chapga manfiy.

collision_v1.name: To'qnashuvdan keyingi tezlik (1-jism)
collision_v1.description: e = 1 — absolyut elastik, e = 0 — absolyut noelastik to'qnashuv (jismlar birga harakatlanadi).

collision_v2.name: To'qnashuvdan keyingi tezlik (2-jism)
collision_v2.description: e = 1 — absolyut elastik, e = 0 — absolyut noelastik to'qnashuv.

collision_energy_loss.name: To'qnashuvda kinetik energiya yo'qotilishi
collision_energy_loss.description: Noelastik to'qnashuvda kinetik energiyaning bir qismi ichki energiyaga (issiqlikka) aylanadi; e = 1 da ΔE = 0.

centripetal_acceleration.name: Markazga intilma tezlanish
centripetal_acceleration.description: Aylana bo'ylab tekis harakatda tezlanish markazga yo'nalgan.

linear_speed.name: Chiziqli tezlik
linear_speed.description: Aylana bo'ylab harakatlanayotgan nuqtaning chiziqli tezligi.

centripetal_force.name: Markazga intilma kuch
centripetal_force.description: Jismni aylana bo'ylab ushlab turuvchi kuch (ipning taranglik kuchi).

circular_period.name: Aylanish davri
circular_period.description: Bir marta to'liq aylanish uchun ketgan vaqt.

torque.name: Kuch momenti
torque.description: Kuch momenti kuchning aylanish o'qidan qo'yilish nuqtasigacha bo'lgan masofaga va sterjen bilan kuch orasidagi burchak sinusiga bog'liq.

rod_inertia.name: Sterjenning inersiya momenti
rod_inertia.description: Bir jinsli ingichka sterjen uchun Shteyner teoremasi; d — sterjen markazidan aylanish o'qigacha masofa.

angular_acceleration.name: Aylanma harakat dinamikasi
angular_acceleration.description: Aylanma harakat uchun Nyutonning ikkinchi qonuni.

potential_energy.name: Potensial energiya
potential_energy.description: Yer sirtidan h balandlikdagi jismning potensial energiyasi.

mechanical_energy_landing.name: Qarshilik bilan tushishda mexanik energiya
mechanical_energy_landing.latex: E = Eₖ + Eₚ = m·g·h·(1 − k),  Q = k·m·g·h
mechanical_energy_landing.description: Qarshilik kuchi og'irlikning k ulushiga teng bo'lsa, yerga tushganda mexanik energiyaning k qismi issiqlikka (Q) aylanadi; Eₖ + Eₚ + Q = mgh saqlanadi.

linear_expansion.name: Chiziqli issiqlik kengayishi
linear_expansion.description: Qizdirilganda sterjen uzunligining ortishi. Natija millimetrda.

expanded_length.name: Qizdirilgan sterjen uzunligi
expanded_length.description: Harorat ΔT ga o'zgargandan keyingi uzunlik.

sensible_heat.name: Isitish uchun issiqlik miqdori
sensible_heat.description: Agregat holat o'zgarmasdan jismni ΔT ga isitish uchun kerak bo'lgan issiqlik.

specific_heat_calc.name: Solishtirma issiqlik sig'imini aniqlash
specific_heat_calc.description: Berilgan issiqlik va o'lchangan harorat o'zgarishidan moddaning solishtirma issiqlik sig'imi.

heating_time.name: Isitish vaqti
heating_time.description: Quvvati P bo'lgan isitgich Q issiqlikni (yo'qotishlarsiz) qancha vaqtda beradi.

latent_heat.name: Erish (bug'lanish) issiqligi
latent_heat.description: Agregat holat o'zgarishi o'zgarmas haroratda boradi. Muz uchun λ = 334 000 J/kg, suv uchun r = 2 260 000 J/kg — kalkulyatorga tegishli solishtirma issiqlikni kiriting.

conduction_flux.name: Furye qonuni (issiqlik o'tkazuvchanlik)
conduction_flux.description: Sterjen orqali vaqt birligida yuza birligidan o'tadigan issiqlik (statsionar holat). ΔT kelvinda va gradusda bir xil.

radiation_flux.name: Stefan–Bolsman qonuni (nurlanish)
radiation_flux.description: Sirtning nurlanish orqali sof issiqlik yo'qotishi. Harorat albatta kelvinda: T = t + 273,15.

ideal_gas_volume.name: Mendeleyev–Klapeyron tenglamasi (hajm)
ideal_gas_volume.description: Ideal gaz hajmi; R = 8,314 J/(mol·K), 1 atm = 101 325 Pa. Natija litrda.

ideal_gas_temperature.name: Mendeleyev–Klapeyron tenglamasi (harorat)
ideal_gas_temperature.description: Bosim, hajm va modda miqdoridan gazning absolyut harorati.

equilibrium_temperature.name: Issiqlik balansi tenglamasi
equilibrium_temperature.description: Issiq va sovuq jism aralashgandan keyingi umumiy harorat (atrofga issiqlik yo'qotilmaydi): Q_berilgan = Q_olingan.

heat_released.name: Sovishda ajralgan issiqlik
heat_released.description: Issiq jism t₁ dan t gacha soviganda bergan issiqlik miqdori.

carnot_efficiency.name: Karno siklining FIK
carnot_efficiency.description: Ideal issiqlik mashinasining eng katta foydali ish koeffitsienti; haroratlar faqat kelvinda.

isothermal_heat.name: Izotermik jarayonda issiqlik
isothermal_heat.description: Izotermik kengayishda gaz olgan issiqlik to'liq ishga aylanadi.

carnot_work.name: Karno siklida bajarilgan ish
carnot_work.latex: W = Q_H − Q_C = n·R·(T_H − T_C)·ln(V₂ / V₁)
carnot_work.description: Bir sikl davomida gaz bajargan foydali ish (V₁ → V₂ — izotermik kengayish hajmlari).

entropy_isothermal.name: Izotermik jarayonda entropiya o'zgarishi
entropy_isothermal.description: O'zgarmas haroratda qaytar uzatilgan issiqlik uchun.

entropy_isobaric.name: Izobarik isitishda entropiya o'zgarishi
entropy_isobaric.latex: ΔS = n·Cₚ·ln(T₂ / T₁),  T₂ = T₁ + Q / (n·Cₚ)
entropy_isobaric.description: Bir atomli ideal gaz uchun Cₚ = 5R/2 ≈ 20,785 J/(mol·K).

isobaric_final_temperature.name: Izobarik isitishdan keyingi harorat
isobaric_final_temperature.description: O'zgarmas bosimda Q issiqlik berilgandan keyingi harorat.

adiabatic_temperature.name: Adiabatik jarayonda harorat
adiabatic_temperature.description: Issiqlik almashinuvisiz (Q = 0) qaytar siqilishda gaz qiziydi, entropiya o'zgarmaydi. Bir atomli gaz uchun γ = 5/3.

ohm.name: Om qonuni (tok kuchi)
ohm.description: Zanjir qismidagi tok kuchi kuchlanishga to'g'ri, qarshilikka teskari proporsional. Natija amperda (1 A = 1000 mA).

resistance.name: Om qonuni (qarshilik)
resistance.description: O'lchangan kuchlanish va tok kuchidan qarshilikni aniqlash.

series_resistance.name: Ketma-ket ulanish
series_resistance.description: Ketma-ket ulanganda tok hamma rezistorda bir xil, kuchlanishlar qo'shiladi.

parallel_resistance.name: Parallel ulanish
parallel_resistance.description: Parallel ulanganda kuchlanish hamma tarmoqda bir xil, toklar qo'shiladi; umumiy qarshilik eng kichigidan ham kichik.

parallel_resistance_2.name: Ikki rezistorning parallel ulanishi
parallel_resistance_2.description: Parallel ulangan ikki tarmoqning ekvivalent qarshiligi.

kirchhoff_i1.name: Asosiy tok (Kirxgof qonunlari)
kirchhoff_i1.description: R₁ ga ketma-ket ulangan R₂ ∥ R₃ zanjirdagi asosiy tok. Tugun: I₁ = I₂ + I₃; kontur: ℰ = I₁R₁ + I₂R₂.

kirchhoff_i2.name: R₂ tarmog'idagi tok
kirchhoff_i2.description: Tok parallel tarmoqlar orasida qarshiliklarga teskari proporsional taqsimlanadi.

kirchhoff_i3.name: R₃ tarmog'idagi tok
kirchhoff_i3.description: Kirxgofning birinchi qonuni bo'yicha I₃ = I₁ − I₂.

rc_time_constant.name: RC zanjirning vaqt doimiysi
rc_time_constant.description: τ vaqtda kondensator kuchlanishi oxirgi qiymatining 63,2 % iga yetadi; 5τ dan keyin jarayon amalda tugaydi (99,3 %). Natija millisekundda.

rc_charging_voltage.name: Zaryadlanishda kondensator kuchlanishi
rc_charging_voltage.description: Bo'sh kondensator U₀ manbaga R orqali ulangandan t vaqt o'tgach.

rc_discharging_voltage.name: Razryadlanishda kondensator kuchlanishi
rc_discharging_voltage.description: U₀ gacha zaryadlangan kondensator R orqali razryadlanganda t vaqtdan keyingi kuchlanish.

rc_time_to_fraction.name: Berilgan darajagacha zaryadlanish vaqti
rc_time_to_fraction.description: Kondensator kuchlanishi oxirgi qiymatning p foiziga yetishi uchun ketadigan vaqt (p = 50 % da t = τ·ln 2).

capacitor_energy.name: Kondensator energiyasi
capacitor_energy.description: Zaryadlangan kondensatorning elektr maydon energiyasi. Natija millijoulda.

power_i2r.name: Quvvat (tok va qarshilik orqali)
power_i2r.description: Joul–Lens qonunidan: rezistorda ajraladigan issiqlik quvvati.

power_u2r.name: Quvvat (kuchlanish va qarshilik orqali)
power_u2r.description: Parallel ulangan iste'molchilar quvvatini hisoblash uchun qulay.

energy_kwh.name: Elektr energiya sarfi
energy_kwh.description: Quvvati P (vatt) bo'lgan asbob t soatda sarflagan energiya kilovatt-soatda.

coulomb_force.name: Kulon qonuni
coulomb_force.description: Ikki nuqtaviy zaryadning o'zaro ta'sir kuchi; bir ishorali zaryadlar itarishadi, har xil ishoralilar tortishadi. Zaryad mikrokulonda (1 µC = 10⁻⁶ C), masofa metrda.

point_charge_field.name: Nuqtaviy zaryad maydoni
point_charge_field.description: Nuqtaviy zaryaddan r masofadagi elektr maydon kuchlanganligi.

two_charge_field.name: Ikki zaryad maydoni (superpozitsiya)
two_charge_field.latex: E⃗ = E⃗₁ + E⃗₂,  E⃗ᵢ = k·qᵢ·r⃗ᵢ / rᵢ³
two_charge_field.description: (x, y) nuqtadagi natijaviy maydon — har bir zaryad maydonlarining vektor yig'indisi.

diode_current.name: Diod toki (soddalashtirilgan model)
diode_current.latex: I = (U − U_f) / R,  U > U_f;  aks holda I ≈ 0
diode_current.description: To'g'ri ulangan diodda kuchlanish tushuvi taxminan o'zgarmas: Si ≈ 0,7 V, Ge ≈ 0,3 V, qizil LED ≈ 1,8 V. Simulyatsiya aniqroq Shokli modelidan foydalanadi, shuning uchun natijalar 1–2 % farq qilishi mumkin.

wire_field.name: To'g'ri tok magnit maydoni
wire_field.description: Uzun to'g'ri o'tkazgichdan r masofadagi magnit induksiya. Natija mikroteslada.

dipole_axial_field.name: Magnit o'qidagi maydon
dipole_axial_field.description: Magnit momenti p_m bo'lgan magnit (dipol) o'qida, markazdan r masofada (r ≫ magnit o'lchami). Natija millitesla.

solenoid_field.name: Solenoid (elektromagnit) maydoni
solenoid_field.description: Uzun g'altak ichidagi magnit induksiya. Havo uchun μr = 1, temir o'zak uchun μr ~ 5000 (lekin temir ~2 T da to'yinadi). Natija millitesla.

faraday_emf.name: Faradeyning elektromagnit induksiya qonuni
faraday_emf.description: Induksiya EYuK magnit oqimining o'zgarish tezligiga proporsional; minus ishorasi Lens qoidasini ifodalaydi. ΔΦ milliveberda.

induced_current.name: Induksiya toki
induced_current.description: Yopiq kontur qarshiligi R bo'lsa induksiya toki; uning yo'nalishi oqim o'zgarishiga qarshilik qiladi (Lens qoidasi).

transformer_voltage.name: Transformatsiya koeffitsienti
transformer_voltage.description: Ideal transformatorda ikkilamchi kuchlanish o'ramlar soniga proporsional.

transformer_secondary_current.name: Ikkilamchi chulg'am toki
transformer_secondary_current.description: Yuklama qarshiligi R ga ulangan ikkilamchi chulg'amdagi tok.

transformer_primary_current.name: Birlamchi chulg'am toki
transformer_primary_current.description: Ideal transformatorda quvvat saqlanadi: kuchlanishni oshirsa, tokni shuncha marta kamaytiradi.

generator_peak_emf.name: Generator EYuK amplitudasi
generator_peak_emf.description: Bir jinsli magnit maydonda aylanayotgan ramkadagi EYuK: ℰ(t) = ℰ₀·sin ωt. n — minutiga aylanishlar soni.

rpm_to_frequency.name: Aylanish chastotasi
rpm_to_frequency.description: Minutiga aylanishlar sonidan o'zgaruvchan tok chastotasi (bir juft qutbli generator).

ampere_force.name: Amper kuchi
ampere_force.description: Magnit maydonga tik joylashgan N o'ramli ramka tomoniga ta'sir etuvchi kuch.

motor_max_torque.name: Ramkaga ta'sir etuvchi eng katta moment
motor_max_torque.description: Ramka tekisligi maydon chiziqlariga parallel bo'lganda aylantiruvchi moment eng katta; o'rtacha moment M̄ = (2/π)·NBIS.

motor_rpm.name: Laboratoriya dvigatelining barqaror tezligi
motor_rpm.description: Barqaror rejimda o'rtacha aylantiruvchi moment qarshilik momentiga (b·ω) teng. Laboratoriya dvigateli: N = 50, S = 20 cm², b = 5·10⁻³ N·m·s.

reflection_angle.name: Yorug'likning qaytish qonuni
reflection_angle.description: Qaytish burchagi tushish burchagiga teng; ikkala burchak sirtga o'tkazilgan normaldan o'lchanadi.

normal_reflectance.name: Tik tushishda qaytarish koeffitsienti
normal_reflectance.description: Ikki shaffof muhit chegarasidan tik tushgan yorug'likning qaytgan ulushi (Frenel formulasi).

snell_angle.name: Snell qonuni (sinish burchagi)
snell_angle.description: Optik zichroq muhitga o'tganda nur normalga yaqinlashadi. n₁ sin α / n₂ > 1 bo'lsa to'liq ichki qaytish ro'y beradi.

critical_angle.name: To'liq ichki qaytish chegaraviy burchagi
critical_angle.description: Tushish burchagi α₀ dan katta bo'lsa yorug'lik to'liq qaytadi (optik tolalar shu hodisaga asoslangan).

refractive_index_from_angles.name: Sindirish ko'rsatkichini aniqlash
refractive_index_from_angles.description: O'lchangan tushish va sinish burchaklaridan ikkinchi muhitning sindirish ko'rsatkichi.

cauchy_index.name: Koshi formulasi (shisha dispersiyasi)
cauchy_index.description: BK7 optik shishaning sindirish ko'rsatkichi to'lqin uzunligi kamayishi bilan ortadi (binafsha nur kuchliroq sinadi).

cauchy_dispersion.name: Sindirish ko'rsatkichlari farqi
cauchy_dispersion.description: Ikki to'lqin uzunligi uchun shisha sindirish ko'rsatkichlarining farqi (Koshi formulasi bo'yicha, BK7 shisha).

prism_min_deviation.name: Prizmada eng kichik og'ish burchagi
prism_min_deviation.description: Nur prizma ichida asosga parallel (simmetrik) o'tganda og'ish burchagi eng kichik bo'ladi.

prism_angular_dispersion.name: Prizmaning burchak dispersiyasi
prism_angular_dispersion.latex: Δδ = δ(λ₁) − δ(λ₂),  δ = θ₁ + θ₂' − A
prism_angular_dispersion.description: Ikki rangli nurning og'ish burchaklari farqi. Simulyatsiyadagidek: BK7 shisha, nur natriy chizig'i (589,3 nm) uchun eng kichik og'ish holatida tushadi.

thin_lens_image.name: Yupqa linza formulasi
thin_lens_image.description: Ishoralar: yig'uvchi linza F > 0, sochuvchi F < 0; f > 0 — haqiqiy tasvir, f < 0 — mavhum tasvir. d = F da tasvir hosil bo'lmaydi (cheksizlikda).

lens_magnification.name: Linzaning chiziqli kattalashtirishi
lens_magnification.description: Γ < 0 — teskari (haqiqiy) tasvir, Γ > 0 — to'g'ri (mavhum) tasvir; |Γ| > 1 — kattalashgan.

optical_power.name: Linzaning optik kuchi
optical_power.description: Optik kuch dioptriyalarda; sochuvchi linzada manfiy. Kalkulyatorga F ni santimetrda kiriting.

mirror_image.name: Sferik ko'zgu formulasi
mirror_image.description: Botiq ko'zgu F > 0, qavariq ko'zgu F < 0; f > 0 — ko'zgu oldidagi haqiqiy tasvir, f < 0 — ko'zgu orqasidagi mavhum tasvir.

mirror_magnification.name: Ko'zguning chiziqli kattalashtirishi
mirror_magnification.description: Γ < 0 — teskari haqiqiy tasvir, Γ > 0 — to'g'ri mavhum tasvir.

fringe_spacing.name: Interferension polosalar orasidagi masofa (Yung)
fringe_spacing.description: Ikki tirqishdan ekranda hosil bo'lgan qo'shni yorug' polosalar oralig'i (kichik burchaklar).

wavelength_from_fringes.name: Polosalardan to'lqin uzunligini aniqlash
wavelength_from_fringes.description: O'lchangan polosalar oralig'idan yorug'lik to'lqin uzunligi (nanometrda).

single_slit_minimum.name: Bitta tirqishdagi difraksiya minimumlari
single_slit_minimum.description: Tirqish kengligi a bo'lganda m-tartibli qorong'i polosaning burchagi.

central_maximum_width.name: Markaziy maksimum kengligi
central_maximum_width.latex: b = 2L·tg φ₁,  sin φ₁ = λ / a
central_maximum_width.description: Ekrandagi markaziy yorug' dog'ning ikki birinchi minimum orasidagi kengligi.

brewster_angle.name: Bryuster qonuni
brewster_angle.description: Shu burchakda qaytgan nur to'liq qutblangan, qaytgan va singan nurlar o'zaro perpendikulyar.

malus_law.name: Malyus qonuni
malus_law.description: Chiziqli qutblangan yorug'lik analizatordan o'tganda intensivlik qutblanish tekisligi va analizator o'qi orasidagi burchakka bog'liq.

reflection_polarization_degree.name: Qaytgan nurning qutblanish darajasi
reflection_polarization_degree.description: Rₛ va Rₚ — Frenel formulalari bo'yicha s- va p-qutblanishlar uchun qaytarish koeffitsientlari; α = α_B da Rₚ = 0 va P = 100 %.

analyzer_transmission.name: Analizatordan o'tgan qaytgan yorug'lik
analyzer_transmission.description: Tabiiy yorug'lik qaytgandan keyin analizatordan o'tgan ulushi; φ — analizator o'qi va s-yo'nalish orasidagi burchak.

wave_speed.name: To'lqin tezligi
wave_speed.description: To'lqin bir davrda bir to'lqin uzunligiga siljiydi. Uzunlik pikselda kiritilsa, natija px/s da chiqadi.

wavelength_from_speed.name: To'lqin uzunligi
wavelength_from_speed.description: Muhitdagi to'lqin tezligi va chastotadan to'lqin uzunligi (havoda tovush tezligi ≈ 343 m/s, 20 °C).

harmonic_frequency.name: Tordagi turg'un to'lqin chastotalari
harmonic_frequency.description: Ikki uchi mahkamlangan torda faqat garmonikalar hosil bo'ladi: νₙ = n·ν₁.

standing_wavelength.name: Turg'un to'lqin uzunligi
standing_wavelength.description: Tor uzunligiga yarim to'lqinlarning butun soni joylashadi; tugunlar soni n + 1, do'ngliklar soni n.

natural_frequency.name: Xususiy tebranish chastotasi
natural_frequency.description: Tashqi kuchsiz tebranayotgan prujinali sistemaning chastotasi.

resonance_amplitude.name: Majburiy tebranishlar amplitudasi
resonance_amplitude.description: Majburlovchi kuch chastotasi xususiy chastotaga yaqinlashganda amplituda keskin ortadi (rezonans). r = 1 da A/Aₛₜ = 1/(2ζ).

quality_factor.name: Tebranish sistemasining asilligi
quality_factor.description: Asillik qancha katta bo'lsa, rezonans cho'qqisi shuncha baland va tor.

resonance_peak_frequency.name: Rezonans chastotasi (amplituda maksimumi)
resonance_peak_frequency.description: So'nish bor bo'lganda amplituda maksimumi xususiy chastotadan biroz pastda bo'ladi.

doppler.name: Dopler effekti (tovush)
doppler.description: v_k — kuzatuvchining manba tomon tezligi, v_m — manbaning kuzatuvchi tomon tezligi (yaqinlashsa musbat, uzoqlashsa manfiy). Havoda v = 343 m/s.

nodal_lines.name: Interferensiya minimum chiziqlari soni
nodal_lines.description: Oralig'i d bo'lgan ikki kogerent manba orasida hosil bo'ladigan so'nish (tugun) chiziqlari soni. d va λ bir xil birlikda (masalan, px).

em_frequency.name: Elektromagnit to'lqin chastotasi
em_frequency.description: Vakuumda barcha elektromagnit to'lqinlar yorug'lik tezligida tarqaladi.

photon_energy_ev.name: Foton energiyasi
photon_energy_ev.description: To'lqin uzunligi qancha qisqa bo'lsa, foton energiyasi shuncha katta.

beat_frequency.name: Urishlar chastotasi
beat_frequency.description: Yaqin chastotali ikki tebranish qo'shilganda amplituda shu chastota bilan kuchayib-susayadi.

beat_period.name: Urishlar davri
beat_period.description: Ikki ketma-ket eng baland tovush orasidagi vaqt.

photon_energy_freq.name: Foton energiyasi (Plank formulasi)
photon_energy_freq.description: Chastota teragersda (1 THz = 10¹² Hz), natija elektronvoltda.

photoelectric_ke.name: Fotoeffekt uchun Eynshteyn tenglamasi
photoelectric_ke.description: Fotoelektronlarning eng katta kinetik energiyasi yorug'lik intensivligiga bog'liq emas, faqat chastotaga bog'liq. hν ≤ W bo'lsa elektronlar chiqmaydi.

threshold_frequency.name: Fotoeffektning qizil chegarasi
threshold_frequency.description: Bundan past chastotali yorug'lik, intensivligi qancha katta bo'lmasin, elektron urib chiqara olmaydi.

stopping_voltage.name: Tormozlovchi kuchlanish
stopping_voltage.description: Fotoelektronlarni to'liq to'xtatadigan teskari kuchlanish; son jihatdan Eₖ_max (eV) ga teng.

bohr_energy.name: Vodorod atomining energetik sathlari
bohr_energy.description: Bor modelida elektron faqat ruxsat etilgan orbitalarda bo'ladi; n = 1 — asosiy holat.

rydberg_wavelength.name: Ridberg formulasi
rydberg_wavelength.description: Elektron n₂ sathdan n₁ sathga o'tganda nurlangan foton to'lqin uzunligi. n₁ = 2 — Balmer seriyasi (ko'rinadigan).

transition_energy.name: O'tishda nurlanadigan foton energiyasi
transition_energy.description: Borning ikkinchi postulati: hν = E_yuqori − E_quyi.

remaining_nuclei.name: Radioaktiv yemirilish qonuni
remaining_nuclei.description: Har yarim yemirilish davrida yemirilmagan yadrolar soni ikki marta kamayadi (statistik qonun).

decay_constant.name: Yemirilish doimiysi
decay_constant.description: Bir yadroning vaqt birligida yemirilish ehtimoli.

mass_defect_energy.name: Massa defekti va energiya
mass_defect_energy.description: Reaksiyada massa kamaygan bo'lsa, shu massaga ekvivalent energiya ajraladi.

fission_energy_mass.name: Uran yoqilg'isi energiyasi
fission_energy_mass.description: m gramm ²³⁵U to'liq bo'linganda ajraladigan energiya (bir bo'linishda E₁ ≈ 200 MeV, 1 MeV = 1,602·10⁻¹³ J).

bragg_angle.name: Vulf–Bregg sharti
bragg_angle.description: Kristall tekisliklaridan qaytgan rentgen nurlari θ sirpanish burchagida kuchayadi (θ tekislik bilan nur orasidagi burchak, og'ish 2θ).
